name: semantic-search
description: Vault-native semantic search using local embeddings
_overrides_note: LOAD-BEARING FOR THE INSTALLER, NOT A VERSION BUMP FOR ITS OWN SAKE.
install.sh installs this package with --ignore-scripts, which is a deliberate security
control (see CHANGELOG and docs/install-security.md): it stops a compromised transitive
dependency executing a lifecycle script during install. @xenova/transformers pulls sharp
transitively, and sharp 0.32.x fetches/builds its native binary from an INSTALL SCRIPT.
Under --ignore-scripts that script never runs, npm still exits 0, and the binary is absent
-- then transformers imports sharp at top level and the whole feature is dead while the
sharp 0.33+ ships its platform binaries as PREBUILT OPTIONAL DEPENDENCIES (@img/sharp-*)
resolved by normal dependency resolution, so it needs no install script at all. Pinning
the transitive sharp to ^0.33.5 makes the feature work UNDER the security flag instead of
asking anyone to weaken it. Removing this override silently re-breaks a clean install --
